==About Voicelines==
{{VO
|character               = Aalto
|language                = en

|vo_01_01_title          = Thoughts: I
|vo_01_01_file           = {character}{language} Thoughts I.ogg
|vo_01_01_tx             = Being a broker such as myself, it is essential to establish good relationships to maintain a stable customer base. You still have some uncertainties about this world, it seems. We should really establish a connection, you know? If there's ever anything you wish to know in the future, I'll make sure you receive the best price for my services.

|vo_01_02_title          = Thoughts: II
|vo_01_02_intimacy       = 1
|vo_01_02_file           = {character}{language} Thoughts II.ogg
|vo_01_02_tx             = Since we're buddies now, here's some quick business tips. Like they say in [[Huanglong]], "your sweet deal might be someone else's poison." It's all about perspective. You can sell the same intel for different prices depending on who you're selling to. Just a little bit of spin and you've got yourself a high-paying customer. Hmm? Nuh-uh, that's not lying! I'd like to call it reasonable strategy in meeting various demands.

|vo_01_03_title          = Thoughts: III
|vo_01_03_intimacy       = 2
|vo_01_03_file           = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg
|vo_01_03_tx             = Being "popular" attracts wealth… and sometimes unwanted attention. You get the occasional oddball who tries to push for a deal. Well, special customers call for special measures. If only all of 'em were as chill to talk to as you.

|vo_01_04_title          = Thoughts: IV
|vo_01_04_intimacy       = 3
|vo_01_04_file           = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg
|vo_01_04_tx             = Info brokers love to play games with their words. You can't just believe everything they say, but you can't ignore them either. It's like trying to see through fog, but if you put in the effort, you'll uncover real gems hidden beneath their half-truths. But with me, it's easy. You know me, I've always been honest with you, buddy.

|vo_01_05_title          = Thoughts: V
|vo_01_05_intimacy       = 4
|vo_01_05_file           = {character}{language} Thoughts V.ogg
|vo_01_05_tx             = I've been told I'm all about networking, not real friendships. Well, can't say I'd deny that. I don't want anything getting in the way of my judgment, so I tend to keep things strictly business with everyone. But now, I guess you're different. You always are. You have a way of swaying my decisions just by being around, as my friend or not.

<!-- Miscellaneous -->
|vo_02_01_title          = {character}’s Hobby
|vo_02_01_file           = {character}{language} Hobby.ogg
|vo_02_01_tx             = In our line of work, being too buddy-buddy with people and exposing weaknesses is a big no-no. Hmm… I can't say 'No' to you, I guess. I don't have anything in particular for hobbies, just some little mist tricks to give everyone a good laugh from time to time.

|vo_02_02_title          = {character}’s Trouble
|vo_02_02_file           = {character}{language} Trouble.ogg
|vo_02_02_tx             = With everything in this world so unpredictable, why sweat yourself all the time? When you're feeling gloomy, just hit me up. I'll get you straightened out, no strings attached.

|vo_02_03_title          = Favorite Food
|vo_02_03_file           = {character}{language} Favorite Food.ogg
|vo_02_03_tx             = Encore's Coral Bowl looks weird, but it sure tastes great. It practically dissolves on your tongue and leaves a nice, mellow flavor. You should give it a try. C'mon, what's up with the side eye? You've got to trust me on this one. The stuff may look like coral, but it's completely harmless, really.
|vo_02_03_mention        = Encore

|vo_02_04_title          = Disliked Food
|vo_02_04_file           = {character}{language} Disliked Food.ogg
|vo_02_04_tx             = You know how some people make all kinds of excuses for their poor decisions? Take my old man, for example, pointing the finger at booze for his messed up life. Better stay away from things that numb your mind, don't you agree?

|vo_02_05_title          = Ideals
|vo_02_05_file           = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg
|vo_02_05_tx             = To live free as the mist and enjoy your life while it lasts. Sounds wonderful, doesn't it?

<!-- Chat -->
|vo_03_01_title          = Chat: I
|vo_03_01_file           = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg
|vo_03_01_tx             = Hmm, curious about what this is? Nope—not a bone flute, it's a tape recorder. Funny little devices like this always come in handy in a pinch. Why don't we get you some next time?

|vo_03_02_title          = Chat: II
|vo_03_02_file           = {character}{language} Chat II.ogg
|vo_03_02_tx             = Believe it or not but when I was young, our house was like a revolving door for debt collectors, thanks to my dad's gambling habit. Boy, did I hate my life having to put up with it all back then. So hey, don't you think your poor buddy deserves a few extra clients, after everything he's been through?

<!-- About Others -->
|vo_04_01_title          = About [[Encore]]
|vo_04_01_intimacy       = 1
|vo_04_01_file           = {character}{language} About Encore.ogg
|vo_04_01_tx             = Sometimes not even I can figure out just where Encore's getting all that energy from. As soon as we arrive somewhere, she's off making friends and sharing stories with the local kids in no time. I even got some of my intel from her buddies, believe it or not.
|vo_04_01_mention        = Encore

|vo_04_02_title          = About [[Jiyan]]
|vo_04_02_intimacy       = 2
|vo_04_02_file           = {character}{language} About Jiyan.ogg
|vo_04_02_tx             = Being the Jinzhou Garrison's General is no walk in the park. You gotta have that big-picture thinking, be on top of everything, and make decisions like they're nothing. Just take a look at General Jiyan—he's got all those boxes checked off and then some.
|vo_04_02_mention        = Jiyan

|vo_04_03_title          = About [[Chixia]]
|vo_04_03_intimacy       = 3
|vo_04_03_file           = {character}{language} About Chixia.ogg
|vo_04_03_tx             = Oh, Miss Chixia. Our first convo didn't go quite as planned. I was doing some business in Jinzhou at the time, then she tried to arrest me, probably thought I was some crook. Lucky for me we worked it out later.
|vo_04_03_mention        = Chixia

|vo_04_04_title          = About [[Yangyang]]
|vo_04_04_intimacy       = 3
|vo_04_04_file           = {character}{language} About Yangyang.ogg
|vo_04_04_tx             = Miss Yangyang? We haven't talked much, but the way she can tap into the "Streams" for intel is definitely something. As someone in the information game, that really sounds handy. I should see if she's interested in being my informant.
|vo_04_04_mention        = Yangyang

|vo_04_05_title          = About [[Baizhi]]
|vo_04_05_intimacy       = 4
|vo_04_05_file           = {character}{language} About Baizhi.ogg
|vo_04_05_tx             = Hmm… Seems unlikely she'll ever be my client. She's the type of person to trust the conclusions from her own research over information provided by anyone else.
|vo_04_05_mention        = Baizhi

|vo_04_06_title          = About [[Mortefi]]
|vo_04_06_intimacy       = 4
|vo_04_06_file           = {character}{language} About Mortefi.ogg
|vo_04_06_tx             = The Academy's red-haired international research fellow? I heard he's got a way of handling difficult clients. Actually... I was thinking about asking him for some pointers.
|vo_04_06_mention        = Mortefi

|vo_04_07_title          = About [[Calcharo]]
|vo_04_07_intimacy       = 5
|vo_04_07_file           = {character}{language} About Calcharo.ogg
|vo_04_07_tx             = I always enjoy doing business with a Ghost Hound. They keep things clean, They're straightforward, and they don't goof around.
|vo_04_07_mention        = Calcharo

|vo_04_08_title          = About [[Verina]]
|vo_04_08_intimacy       = 5
|vo_04_08_file           = {character}{language} About Verina.ogg
|vo_04_08_tx             = That little girl from Rigg's Explorers? Yeah, I bumped into her once, back in the [[New Federation]]. Offered me a Starflower for the whereabouts of her mother. But the deal fell through, because she didn't have what I was asking for. And what was that, you ask? Well… I asked for a never-withering flower. In reply, she told me plants have their life cycle, and wilting is just a natural part of it. I remember telling her, "The same can be said for humans."
|vo_04_08_mention        = Verina

<!-- Birthday -->
|vo_05_01_title          = Birthday Wishes
|vo_05_01_file           = {character}{language} Birthday Wishes.ogg
|vo_05_01_tx             = Heya! Happy Birthday, my most special patron! Got you a custom-made mist-maker. It may not look like much, but all you have to do is give it a little twist to have mists of all shapes and sizes... And Voila! Here's a kitten for ya, how'd you like it? Now whenever you're feeling down, just turn your troubles into mist and watch them fade away.

<!-- Idles -->
|vo_06_01_title          = Idle: I
|vo_06_01_file           = {character}{language} Idle I.ogg
|vo_06_01_tx             = Credibility in the name, and customer satisfaction is the game.

|vo_06_02_title          = Idle: II
|vo_06_02_file           = {character}{language} Idle II.ogg
|vo_06_02_tx             = I never miss out on a good deal.

|vo_06_03_title          = Idle: III
|vo_06_03_file           = {character}{language} Idle III.ogg
|vo_06_03_tx             = Here's a flower for ya.

<!-- Greetings -->
|vo_07_01_title          = Self-Introduction
|vo_07_01_file           = {character}{language} Self-Introduction.ogg
|vo_07_01_tx             = Howdy! I'm Aalto, your go-to information broker. I've got all the info you need at fair prices. Knowledge about different places is key to staying ahead while you're out and about. Interested in a quote?

|vo_07_02_title          = Greeting
|vo_07_02_file           = {character}{language} Greeting.ogg
|vo_07_02_tx             = G'day. What does our loyal client wish to inquire about today?

<!-- Join Team -->
|vo_08_01_title          = Join Team: I
|vo_08_01_file           = {character}{language} Join Team I.ogg
|vo_08_01_tx             = Any detail along the way could become valuable intel.

|vo_08_02_title          = Join Team: II
|vo_08_02_file           = {character}{language} Join Team II.ogg
|vo_08_02_tx             = Nice pick! You won't regret choosing Aalto's service.

|vo_08_03_title          = Join Team: III
|vo_08_03_file           = {character}{language} Join Team III.ogg
|vo_08_03_tx             = It's go time! You'll have my mist for escort.

<!-- Ascension -->
|vo_09_01_title          = Ascension: I
|vo_09_01_ascension      = 1
|vo_09_01_file           = {character}{language} Ascension I.ogg
|vo_09_01_tx             = Whew—I can make more mist now. Thanks, I'll offer you something extra next time.

|vo_09_02_title          = Ascension: II
|vo_09_02_ascension      = 2
|vo_09_02_file           = {character}{language} Ascension II.ogg
|vo_09_02_tx             = Hmm? You never fail to impress. My mist can reach even further now. Sweet! And that'll be another intel on the house for ya!

|vo_09_03_title          = Ascension: III
|vo_09_03_ascension      = 3
|vo_09_03_file           = {character}{language} Ascension III.ogg
|vo_09_03_tx             = Now I can switch between any kind of mist as I please. Much appreciated, bud! If you need anything, just ask away. I'll do my best to oblige!

|vo_09_04_title          = Ascension: IV
|vo_09_04_ascension      = 4
|vo_09_04_file           = {character}{language} Ascension IV.ogg
|vo_09_04_tx             = Whoa, talk about sincerity. I'll make this worth your while, of course. My mist will be with you at all times, you can trust me to have your back.

|vo_09_05_title          = Ascension: V
|vo_09_05_ascension      = 5
|vo_09_05_file           = {character}{language} Ascension V.ogg
|vo_09_05_tx             = Say, buddy, we should probably take care of those bills you owe me. Let's see here… Hmm, you know what? I actually made a good chunk of change from the intel you asked for, so why don't we just call it even? Swing by anytime and let's do more business!
}}
